title: NodeKit Measurement Log (MEASUREMENT LOG gate)
description: Beliefs that were held, measured, and found false. Not the beliefs that survived - those are the code. Recorded at the moment of falsification and attached at handoff. A passing test suite shows what was checked; only this shows what was believed and found wrong.

entries.description: An empty log claims either that nothing was believed and found false, or that nobody was looking. On a non-trivial build the first is not credible.

believed.description: The belief as it was actually held, in the confident form it was held in. Softening it retroactively destroys the entry's value.

measured.description: The EVIDENCE, not the conclusion. 'Buckets overlap' is a claim; '3,205 vs 2,915' is a measurement. Numbers, commands, outputs.

changed.description: What changed as a result. 'Nothing' is a valid answer and worth recording - it means the belief was wrong but harmless.

recordedAt.description: At the moment of falsification, not at the end. Reconstruction loses the belief: you remember the fix and forget being confident of the opposite an hour earlier.

wouldHaveShipped.description: The defect this prevented. The strongest entries name a plausible, well-formed, completely wrong output.

causedByAPriorFix.description: True when the repair for an earlier entry caused this one. These are the most valuable entries and the least likely to be volunteered.

kind.description: process entries - wrong estimates, misread agent output, searching instead of asking - are the ones a reader trusts the file for, because nobody fabricates them.
